components.classification: one component of the nine-payment redistribution
one component of the nine-payment redistribution

chronology_correction.claim: A November 2 secondary article describes the two 40M payments at 03:55:31 and 03:56:21 as an 80M movement from the hack-linked wallet.
chronology_correction.correction: Those two payments fall inside the already-recorded 03:52:41–04:00:31 nine-payment redistribution of 233,454,920 XRP. They are components of that 233.45M total, not an additional 80M movement after the six-wallet redistribution.
evidence: The 03:56:21 payment is independently listed by Whale Alert with the original attacker account as sender and one of the six known recipients.
The two 40M timestamps are within the Bithomp-captured nine-payment redistribution window.

separate_exchange_transfers.relation_to_exploit: not established; a Nov 2 secondary report explicitly says the transaction data supplied by Whale Alert does not connect it to the attacker address
separate Binance-labeled wallet movement; downstream beneficiary and customer/treasury purpose not established in this run

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The six-wallet split is staging/segmentation before further movement.
competing_hypotheses.support: Six new accounts were activated shortly before the transfers; five received 40M each and one received 33.45492M.
competing_hypotheses.counter: No later outbound movement or monetization has been verified.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The split is an operational concealment step rather than immediate liquidation.
competing_hypotheses.support: The transactions create six separate balances and no exchange/DEX destination was identified in captured recipient histories.
competing_hypotheses.counter: No beneficial-owner or intent evidence is available.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Separate Binance-labeled 30M/50M transfers are ordinary custody/withdrawal rebalancing.
competing_hypotheses.support: They originate from a different Binance-labeled account and are not linked to the attacker in available evidence.
competing_hypotheses.counter: Recipient purpose and account ownership remain unknown.

source_register.type: Whale Alert transaction record for separate Binance 50M transfer
prior captured Bithomp/Whale Alert observation for separate Binance 30M transfer

source_independence.caveat: The nine-payment redistribution was previously reconstructed from Bithomp; Whale Alert independently corroborates one 40M payment, not all nine. TRM/FBI attribution concerns the wider breach and does not independently verify the later six-wallet redistribution.
